answer: Sybil resistance works when joining costs real work that clones cannot reuse. Gate each new identity behind a one-time proof-of-work puzzle whose difficulty rises with join floods; a farm must burn basalt-hard compute per head. Escrow a stake that unlocks only after several graded epochs of coherent answers, so throwaway socks never reach a safe haven of voting power. Track kin-linked recruits and zero their referral share. Identity graphs that share hardware fingerprints stay under an ivory ceiling on seats until independently verified.
